registration_scope: Defined after the fusion comparisons became available, before fitting this label analysis. The labels themselves were frozen by the independent profile route without fusion outcomes.
population: Ordinary Manual, exact fixed background, same pool/reference, same k, different entrant workers with equal bound-pair count. Deduplicate unordered actual team pairs.
comparisons: Same versus different Q2, with supported Q
Within a concrete Q2 label, same versus different QT, with supported Q and source T
Within a concrete QT label, same versus different difficulty_type, with supported easy/medium/hard traits
Within a concrete QT label, same versus different fine_dtype_merged, retaining known not_split/sparse_child labels
labels: Heldout-building fold profiles only. No target building's worker answer Q enters the prediction label. Unknown label substrings are excluded as unclassified and counted, never treated as a low class.
sensitivity: B8-derived labels and D10-derived labels are separately joined to the same fixed actual teams; output B8 and D10 differences both retained. This is reclassification of fixed teams, not score tuning or a rerun of fusion.
aggregation: For each exact pool/k/background/entrant-pair-count/concrete parent class, calculate mean metric in same and different child relation. Subtract same from different only in matched strata. Average strata to image then building; 3000 building bootstrap. Repeated actual teams are not independent people.
limitations: Descriptive conditional contrasts, not causal effects of changing a worker's label. Equal-count restriction is a complexity control using actual target annotations and is separate from prospective label learning. Any actual cluster effects remain oracle. Unknown outputs remain in attempts/failure denominators. Missing scores are not imputed.
